revised_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: iOS app icon candidate, square 1024x1024 raster image
Primary request: Generate candidate B for the Chinese iOS app "步履小屋". Make a more symbolic, less busy icon with stronger app-icon readability and generous iOS safe padding.
Subject: a compact cozy cabin badge, a curved pair of footprint marks leading toward it, and one small folded paper plane above it. No other objects.
Style/medium: premium simplified watercolor travel-journal icon, soft pencil outline, warm paper texture, clean iconic shapes, readable at phone home-screen size.
Composition/framing: square canvas, no rounded corners baked in. Use a centered composition where all main elements fit inside an imaginary central 72% circle/square, leaving at least 15% clear margin to every edge for iOS rounded-corner crop. Cabin is smaller than before, around 52-58% of canvas width; paper plane is above and slightly right, with ample space from the top and right edges; footprints are simple and visible but not near the bottom edge. Full-bleed warm cream paper background.
Lighting/mood: gentle, cozy, calm, travel diary feeling.
Color palette: cream paper, honey yellow light, warm caramel browns, muted olive roof. No blue, no purple, no dark navy.
Materials/textures: subtle watercolor texture, crisp silhouette, simplified details, no clutter.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers.
Constraints: not full-bleed subject, no border, no drop shadow, no inner rounded rectangle, no white corner cutouts, no scenery, no plants, no clouds, no Apple logo, no Health icon, no watermark.
